tools.name: search_hotels
tools.title: FlightPowers: search hotels
tools.summary: FlightPowers hotel search: live Booking.com availability and nightly prices for a destination and date range.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.about: Where to stay, in free text the way a person would write it, e.g. "Rome" or "Tokyo Shibuya".

parameters.name: checkin_date
parameters.about: First night of the stay, "YYYY-MM-DD". With checkout_date it prices one stay; checkin_date_from plus checkin_date_to price a range of check-in dates instead.

parameters.name: checkout_date
parameters.about: Departure morning, "YYYY-MM-DD". Must be after checkin_date.

parameters.name: checkin_date_from
parameters.about: First check-in date of a range, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: checkin_date_to
parameters.about: Last check-in date of the range, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: nights
parameters.about: How many nights to stay, as a number (3) or a list ([2, 3, 7]) to price several lengths.

parameters.name: max_searches
parameters.about: The searches this call may make, up or down. One stay is one request, so a 30-day range at two lengths is 60 and a month at three is 93 -- with the caller's own key the cap rises to cover a request that size by itself.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.about: Number of adult guests. Defaults to the upstream default when omitted.

parameters.name: children
parameters.about: Number of children sharing the room.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.about: ISO currency code for the prices returned, e.g. "usd".

parameters.name: budget_per_night
parameters.about: Only properties at or below this nightly price, in `currency`, are returned.

parameters.name: price_as_seen_from
parameters.about: Two-letter country code, e.g. "de". Prices the stay through a residential connection in that country, so the result is what a shopper resident there would be quoted.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.about: Property filters to apply, e.g. ["free_cancellation", "breakfast_included"].

parameters.name: limit
parameters.about: How many properties to return (default 10; a stay has about 25).

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.about: Returns each property exactly as the source sent it, image URLs and the full tracking link included, and every property unless limit is set.

tools.name: find_hotel_by_name
tools.title: FlightPowers: find one hotel by name
tools.summary: FlightPowers single-property lookup: live Booking.com availability and pricing for one named property.

parameters.name: hotel_name
parameters.about: The property name a person would type, e.g. "Hotel Artemide".

parameters.name: checkin_date
parameters.about: First night of the stay, "YYYY-MM-DD". With checkout_date it prices one stay; checkin_date_from plus checkin_date_to give a rate calendar instead.

parameters.name: checkout_date
parameters.about: Departure morning, "YYYY-MM-DD". Must be after checkin_date.

parameters.name: checkin_date_from
parameters.about: First check-in date of a range, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: checkin_date_to
parameters.about: Last check-in date of the range, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: nights
parameters.about: How many nights to stay, as a number (3) or a list ([2, 3, 7]) to price several lengths.

parameters.name: max_searches
parameters.about: The searches this call may make, up or down. One stay is one request; with the caller's own key the cap rises by itself to cover a month-sized request, and anything past the cap in force is sampled evenly across the calendar rather than cut short at the front.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.about: Number of adult guests.

parameters.name: children
parameters.about: Number of children sharing the room.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.about: ISO currency code for the prices returned, e.g. "usd".

parameters.name: price_as_seen_from
parameters.about: Two-letter country code, e.g. "de". Prices the stay as a shopper resident in that country would see it.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.about: Returns the property exactly as the source sent it, image URL and the full tracking link included.

tools.name: search_airbnb
tools.title: FlightPowers: search Airbnb stays
tools.summary: FlightPowers Airbnb search: live Airbnb stays and prices for a destination and dates, read from Airbnb's public search page at request time.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.about: Free-text place, e.g. "Lisbon" or "Tokyo Shibuya".

parameters.name: checkin_date
parameters.about: First night, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: checkout_date
parameters.about: Departure day, "YYYY-MM-DD", after checkin_date.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.about: Adult guests.

parameters.name: children
parameters.about: Children aged 2 to 12.

parameters.name: infants
parameters.about: Infants under 2.

parameters.name: pets
parameters.about: Pets travelling.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.about: ISO currency code, e.g. "eur"; USD when omitted.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.about: Lowest price per night, in `currency` (Airbnb's nightly rate, before fees).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.about: Highest price per night, in `currency` (Airbnb's nightly rate, before fees; price_total includes fees and can exceed price_max x nights).

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.about: Lowest rating kept, out of 5; unrated stays are left out.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.about: price_asc or price_desc by per-night price, rating_desc by rating; unset keeps Airbnb's order.

parameters.name: min_bedrooms
parameters.about: Fewest bedrooms.

parameters.name: min_beds
parameters.about: Fewest beds.

parameters.name: min_bathrooms
parameters.about: Fewest bathrooms.

parameters.name: room_types
parameters.about: Room types to keep, e.g. ["Entire home/apt"].

parameters.name: limit
parameters.about: Stays returned (default 10), in search order (after `sort`), with the cheapest always included.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.about: Returns the source's full rows (image, coordinates and more), every stay unless limit is set.

tools.name: compare_hotel_rates
tools.title: FlightPowers: compare hotel rates across sources
tools.summary: FlightPowers cross-source comparison: prices one stay on every source the caller has a key for.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.about: Where to stay, in free text the way a person would write it, e.g. "Rome" or "Tokyo Shibuya".

parameters.name: checkin_date
parameters.about: First night of the stay, "YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: checkout_date
parameters.about: Departure morning, "YYYY-MM-DD". Must be after checkin_date.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.about: Number of adult guests. Defaults to the upstream default when omitted.

parameters.name: children
parameters.about: Number of children sharing the room.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.about: ISO currency code for every row, e.g. "usd". Sources are asked for the same currency so the totals are comparable; a row that came back in a different one says so in its own currency field and is not converted.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.about: Which sources to price, e.g. ["booking", "airbnb"].
